body: Additional info, almost always triggers for NGINX and not for actual Apache with current versions. I know this has a tech flag setting, but might be good to add some checks for non-Apache servers in case the user doesn't set tech flags.

rename.to: False-positive: 10053 Apache Range Header DoS (CVE-2011-3192) for nginx

body:
Maybe we should simply consider retiring this rule?

It’s been 10years we really shouldn’t find anything that old anymore. If we do there are likely bigger issues to find 😉

As a suggestion we should consider implementing such checks as scripts in the future. As they seem more targeted in use, quicker to rollout, and less permanent in use. (For my two cents.)

body:
Hello,

I see this is fixed in the code but it has not been made available in the marketplace. Is there any chance this can be updated in the marketplace? We are looking to get rid of this false positive from our reports as well and I believe the docker image will automatically pull the latest update by default, so we would appreciate if this can be made available for that process to take place.
The new version is now available.
Thank you very much. I was able to test it out over the weekend and it works brilliantly with the docker image automatic update. Thanks again!
This issue has been automatically locked since there has not been any recent activity after it was closed. Please open a new issue for related bugs.
